market_outlook.short_term: Volatile but constructive. Iran war keeps oil elevated and inflation sticky, but Fed pause and EM rotation support risk assets. BOJ decision and Fed Williams commentary create two-way volatility. AI names digest strong prints. Expect 2-3% index swings weekly.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously optimistic with structural headwinds. AI capex cycle supports tech leadership through 2027, but Goldman's lower-return warning and $97 oil cap global growth. K-shaped economy persists. Geopolitical fragmentation (China, Iran, Ukraine) adds tail risk. EM structural reforms (India, China YMTC) offer selective upside.
